about_the_game:
In Honk Havoc, there is no stopping. Every jump is inevitable, and every landing a matter of survival.

You play the role of a cursed duck, forever doomed to bounce across an archipelago of deadly traps, treacherous platforms, and merciless spikes. As you progress from island to island, challenges become tougher and lead you through frantic duels against eccentric bosses guarding clues to your next destination.

The hunt for the legendary sandwich requires pinpoint accuracy and nerves of steel. Time every forced jump, memorize chaotic patterns, react to unpredictable hazards, and keep your rhythm through the madness.

With its bright pixel art and tight, challenging gameplay, Honk Havoc is an intense and fast-paced experience. Take part in the epic journey of a duck determined to break his own curse, one jump at a time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3+
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 450 GTS / Radeon HD 5750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 80 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i3+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 460 / Radeon HD 7800 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

short_description: Honk Havoc is a platformer that demands extreme precision: a duck cursed to jump incessantly faces a gauntlet of traps on its quest for the legendary sandwich that can set it free.
supported_languages: English, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil
